title: FAQ: Gold Years Account
summary: This document answers FAQ items for the Gold Years Account regarding fees: a returned deposited check is charged a $0.00 returned deposit fee, and incoming domestic wire transfers have a $0.00 incoming domestic wire transfer fee.
faqs: Is there a fee if a check I deposit is returned unpaid?
What is the incoming domestic wire transfer fee for my Gold Years Account?
Are there any fees for returned deposits or incoming domestic wires on this account?
